verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly describes bill upload/drag-in, automated PO matching, GL coding, approval routing, and payment (ramp-docs-2), which directly matches the finance-lead's AP workflow story, and community evidence corroborates working approval flows for expenses (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of bill-pay approval routing (not just card expense approvals) and detail on multi-step/custom approval chain configuration.
